Taa Haa
Hum ne aap par Quran is liye nahin naazil kiya hai ke aap apne ko zahmat mein daal dein
Yeh to un logon ki yaad-dahaani ke liye hai jin ke dilon mein khauf-e-Khuda hai
Yeh us Khuda ki taraf se naazil hua hai jis ne zameen aur buland-tareen aasmaanon ko paida kiya hai
Woh Rehmaan Arsh par ikhtiyaar o iqtidaar rakhne waala hai
Us ke liye woh sab kuch hai jo aasmaanon mein hai ya zameen mein hai ya dono ke darmiyaan hai aur zameenon ki teh mein hai
Agar tum buland aawaaz se bhi baat karo to woh raaz se bhi makhfi-tar baaton ko jaanne waala hai
Woh Allah hai jis ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, us ke liye behtareen naam hain
Kya tumhaare paas Moosa ki daastaan aayi hai
Jab unhon ne aag ko dekha aur apne ahl se kaha ke tum isi maqaam par thehro, main ne aag ko dekha hai, shaayad main us mein se koi angaara le aaoon ya is manzil par koi rehnumaai haasil kar loon
Phir jab Moosa us aag ke qareeb aaye to aawaaz di gayi ke aye Moosa!
Main tumhaara Parwardigar hoon, lihaaza apni jootiyon ko utaar do ke tum Tuwa naam ki ek muqaddas aur paakeeza waadi mein ho
Aur hum ne tum ko muntakhab kar liya hai, lihaaza jo wahi ki ja rahi hai use ghaur se suno
Main Allah hoon, mere ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, meri ibaadat karo aur meri yaad ke liye namaaz qaaim karo
Yaqeenan woh qiyaamat aane waali hai aur main use chhupaaye rahoonga taake har nafs ko us ki koshish ka badla diya ja sake
Aur khabardaar tumhein qiyaamat ke khayaal se woh shakhs rok na de jis ka imaan qiyaamat par nahin hai aur jis ne apni khwaahishaat ki pairwi ki hai, ke is tarah tum halaak ho jaaoge
Aur aye Moosa! Yeh tumhaare daahine haath mein kya hai
Unhon ne kaha ke yeh mera asa hai jis par main takiya karta hoon, aur is se apni bakriyon ke liye darakhton ki pattiyaan jhaadta hoon, aur is mein mere aur bahut se maqaasid hain
Irshaad hua to Moosa! Ise zameen par daal do
Ab jo Moosa ne daal diya to kya dekha ke woh saanp ban kar daud raha hai
Hukm hua ke ise le lo aur daro nahin, ke hum anqareeb ise is ki puraani asl ki taraf palta denge
Aur apne haath ko samet kar baghal mein kar lo, yeh baghair beemaari ke safed ho kar niklega, aur yeh hamaari doosri nishaani hogi
Taake hum tumhein apni badi nishaaniyaan dikha sakein
Jaao Fir'aun ki taraf jaao ke woh sarkash ho gaya hai
Moosa ne arz ki: Parwardigar! Mere seene ko kushaada kar de
Mere kaam ko aasaan kar de
Aur meri zabaan ki girah ko khol de
Ke yeh log meri baat samajh sakein
Aur mere ahl mein se mera wazeer qaraar de de
Haaroon ko jo mera bhai bhi hai
Is se meri pusht ko mazboot kar de
Ise mere kaam mein shareek bana de
Taake hum teri bahut zyaada tasbeeh kar sakein
Aur tera bahut zyaada zikr kar sakein
Yaqeenan tu hamaare haalaat se behtar baakhabar hai
Irshaad hua: Moosa! Hum ne tumhaari muraad tumhein de di hai
Aur hum ne tum par ek aur ehsaan kiya hai
Jab hum ne tumhaari maa ki taraf ek khaas wahi ki

Ke apne bachche ko sandooq mein rakh do aur phir sandooq ko darya ke hawaale kar do, maujein use saahil par daal dengi, aur ek aisa shakhs use utha lega jo mera bhi dushman hai aur Moosa ka bhi dushman hai. Aur hum ne tum par apni mohabbat ka aks daal diya taake tumhein hamaari nigraani mein paala jaaye

Us waqt ko yaad karo jab tumhaari behan ja rahi thin ke Fir'aun se kahein ke kya main kisi aise ka pata bataaoon jo is ki kafaalat kar sake, aur is tarah hum ne tum ko tumhaari maa ki taraf palta diya taake un ki aankhein thandi ho jaayein aur woh ranjeeda na hon. Aur tum ne ek shakhs ko qatl kar diya to hum ne tumhein gham se najaat de di aur tumhaara baa-qaa'ida imtehaan le liya. Phir tum ahl-e-Madyan mein kai baras tak rahe, us ke baad tum ek manzil par aa gaye, aye Moosa!
Aur hum ne tum ko apne liye muntakhab kar liya
Ab tum apne bhai ke saath meri nishaaniyaan le kar jaao, aur meri yaad mein susti na karna
Tum dono Fir'aun ki taraf jaao ke woh sarkash ho gaya hai
Us se narmi se baat karna ke shaayad woh naseehat qubool kar le ya khaufzada ho jaaye
Un dono ne kaha ke Parwardigar! Humein yeh khauf hai ke kahin woh hum par zyaadati na kare ya aur sarkash na ho jaaye
Irshaad hua tum daro nahin, main tumhaare saath hoon, sab kuch sun bhi raha hoon aur dekh bhi raha hoon

Fir'aun ke paas ja kar kaho ke hum tere Parwardigar ke firistaada hain, Bani Israaeel ko hamaare hawaale kar de aur un par azaab na kar, ke hum tere paas tere Parwardigar ki nishaani le kar aaye hain, aur hamaara salaam ho us par jo hidaayat ka ittibaa' kare
Beshak hamaari taraf yeh wahi ki gayi hai ke takzeeb karne waale aur munh pherne waale par azaab hai
Us ne kaha ke Moosa! Tum dono ka Rab kaun hai
Moosa ne kaha ke hamaara Rab woh hai jis ne har shai ko us ki munaasib khilqat ata ki hai aur phir hidaayat bhi di hai
Us ne kaha ke phir un logon ka kya hoga jo pehle guzar chuke hain
Moosa ne kaha ke in baaton ka ilm mere Parwardigar ke paas us ki kitaab mein mahfooz hai, woh na behakta hai aur na bhoolta hai

Us ne tumhaare liye zameen ko gehwaara banaaya hai aur us mein tumhaare liye raaste banaaye hain, aur aasmaan se paani barsaaya hai jis ke zariye hum ne mukhtalif qism ke nabaataat ka joda paida kiya hai
Ke tum khud bhi khaao aur apne jaanwaron ko bhi charaao. Beshak is mein saahibaan-e-aql ke liye badi nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain
Isi zameen se hum ne tumhein paida kiya hai aur isi mein palta kar le jaayenge, aur phir dobaara isi se nikaalenge
Aur hum ne Fir'aun ko apni saari nishaaniyaan dikhla deen, lekin us ne takzeeb ki aur inkaar kar diya
Us ne kaha ke Moosa! Tum is liye aaye ho ke hum ko hamaare ilaaqe se apne jaadoo ke zariye baahar nikaal do
Ab hum bhi aisa hi jaadoo le aayenge, lihaaza apne aur hamaare darmiyaan ek waqt muqarrar kar do jis ki na hum mukhaalifat karein aur na tum, aur woh waada-gaah bhi ek saaf khule maidaan mein ho
Moosa ne kaha ke tumhaara waade ka din zeenat (Eid) ka din hai, aur us din tamaam log waqt-e-chaasht ikattha kiye jaayenge
Us ke baad Fir'aun waapas chala gaya aur apne makr ko ikattha karne laga, aur us ke baad phir saamne aaya
Moosa ne un logon se kaha ke tum par waae ho! Allah par iftira na karo ke woh tum ko azaab ke zariye tabaah o barbaad kar dega, aur jis ne us par bohtaan baandha woh yaqeenan ruswa hua hai
Is par woh log aapas mein jhagda karne lage aur sargoshiyon mein masroof ho gaye
Un logon ne kaha ke yeh dono jaadoogar hain jo tum logon ko apne jaadoo ke zor par tumhaari sarzameen se nikaal dena chaahte hain aur tumhaare achchhe khaase tareeqe ko mita dena chaahte hain
Lihaaza tum log apni tadbeeron ko jama karo aur para baandh kar un ke muqaable par aa jaao, jo aaj ke din ghaalib aa jaaega wahi kaamyaab kaha jaaega
Un logon ne kaha ke Moosa! Tum apne jaadoo ko phenkoge ya hum log pehal karein
Moosa ne kaha ke nahin, tum ibtida karo. Ek martaba kya dekha ke un ki rassiyaan aur lakdiyaan jaadoo ki bina par aisi lagne lagin jaise sab daud rahi hon
To Moosa ne apne dil mein (qaum ki gumraahi ka) khauf mehsoos kiya
Hum ne kaha ke Moosa! Daro nahin, tum bahar-haal ghaalib rehne waale ho

Aur jo kuch tumhaare haath mein hai use daal do, yeh un ke saare kiye dhare ko chun lega. Un logon ne jo kuch kiya hai woh sirf jaadoogar ki chaal hai aur bas, aur jaadoogar jahaan bhi jaaye kabhi kaamyaab nahin ho sakta
Yeh dekh kar saare jaadoogar sajde mein gir pade aur aawaaz di ke hum Moosa aur Haaroon ke Parwardigar par imaan le aaye

Fir'aun ne kaha ke tum meri ijaazat ke baghair hi imaan le aaye? To yeh tum se bhi bada jaadoogar hai jis ne tumhein jaadoo sikhaaya hai. Ab main tumhaare ek taraf ke haath aur doosri taraf ke paaon kaat doonga aur tumhein khurme ki shaakh par sooli de doonga, aur tumhein khoob maaloom ho jaaega ke zyaada sakht azaab karne waala aur der tak rehne waala kaun hai

Un logon ne kaha ke hamaare paas jo khuli nishaaniyaan aa chuki hain aur jis ne hum ko paida kiya hai hum us par teri baat ko muqaddam nahin kar sakte. Ab tujhe jo faisla karna ho kar le, tu faqat is zindagaani-e-duniya hi tak faisla kar sakta hai

Hum apne Parwardigar par imaan le aaye hain ke woh hamaari khataaon ko maaf kar de aur us jaadoo ko bakhsh de jis par tu ne humein majboor kiya tha, aur Allah sab se behtar hai aur wahi baaqi rehne waala hai
Yaqeenan jo apne Rab ki baargaah mein mujrim ban kar aaega us ke liye woh Jahannam hai jis mein na mar sakega aur na zinda reh sakega
Aur jo us ke huzoor saahib-e-imaan ban kar haazir hoga aur us ne nek aamaal kiye honge us ke liye buland-tareen darajaat hain
Hamesha rehne waali Jannat jis ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi aur woh us mein hamesha rahenge, ke yahi paakeeza kirdaar logon ki jaza hai

Aur hum ne Moosa ki taraf wahi ki ke mere bandon ko le kar raaton raat nikal jaao, phir un ke liye darya mein asa maar kar khushk raasta bana do, tumhein na Fir'aun ke pa lene ka khatra hai aur na doob jaane ka
Tab Fir'aun ne apne lashkar samet un logon ka peechha kiya aur darya ki maujon ne inhein baa-qaa'ida dhaank liya
Aur Fir'aun ne dar-haqeeqat apni qaum ko gumraah hi kiya hai, hidaayat nahin di hai
Bani Israaeel! Hum ne tum ko tumhaare dushman se najaat dilaayi hai, aur Toor ki daahini taraf se Tauraat dene ka waada kiya hai, aur Mann o Salwa bhi naazil kiya hai
Tum hamaare paakeeza rizq ko khaao aur us mein sarkashi aur zyaadati na karo ke tum par mera ghazab naazil ho jaaye, ke jis par mera ghazab naazil ho gaya woh yaqeenan barbaad ho gaya
Aur main bahut zyaada bakhshne waala hoon us shakhs ke liye jo tauba kar le aur imaan le aaye aur nek amal kare aur phir raah-e-hidaayat par saabit-qadam rahe
Aur aye Moosa! Tumhein qaum ko chhod kar jaldi aane par kis shai ne aamaada kiya hai
Moosa ne arz ki ke woh sab mere peechhe aa rahe hain, aur main ne raah-e-khair mein is liye ujlat ki hai ke tu khush ho jaaye
Irshaad hua ke hum ne tumhaare baad tumhaari qaum ka imtehaan liya aur Saamiri ne inhein gumraah kar diya hai

Yeh sun kar Moosa apni qaum ki taraf mahzoon aur ghusse mein bhare hue palte aur kaha ke aye qaum! Kya tumhaare Rab ne tum se behtareen waada nahin kiya tha? Aur kya is ahd mein kuch zyaada tool ho gaya hai, ya tum ne yahi chaaha ke tum par Parwardigar ka ghazab waarid ho jaaye, is liye tum ne mere waade ki mukhaalifat ki

Qaum ne kaha ke hum ne apne ikhtiyaar se aap ke waade ki mukhaalifat nahin ki hai, balke hum par qaum ke zevaraat ka bojh laad diya gaya tha, to hum ne use aag mein daal diya, aur isi tarah Saamiri ne bhi apne zevaraat ko daal diya

Phir Saamiri ne un ke liye ek mujassama gaaye ke bachche ka nikaala jis mein aawaaz bhi thi, aur kaha ke yahi tumhaara aur Moosa ka khuda hai jis se Moosa ghaafil ho kar use Toor par dhoondhne chale gaye hain
Kya yeh log itna bhi nahin dekhte ke yeh na un ki baat ka jawaab de sakta hai aur na un ke kisi nuqsaan ya faaide ka ikhtiyaar rakhta hai
Aur Haaroon ne un logon se pehle hi keh diya ke aye qaum! Is tarah tumhaara imtehaan liya gaya hai, aur tumhaara Rab Rehmaan hi hai, lihaaza mera ittibaa' karo aur mere amr ki itaa'at karo
Un logon ne kaha ke hum is ke gird jama rahenge yahaan tak ke Moosa hamaare darmiyaan waapas aa jaayein
Moosa ne Haaroon se khitaab kar ke kaha ke jab tum ne dekh liya tha ke yeh qaum gumraah ho gayi hai to tumhein kaun si baat aade aa gayi thi
Ke tum ne mera ittibaa' nahin kiya? Kya tum ne mere amr ki mukhaalifat ki hai

Haaroon ne kaha ke bhaiya! Aap meri daadhi aur mera sar na pakdein, mujhe to yeh khauf tha ke kahin aap yeh na kahein ke tum ne Bani Israaeel mein ikhtilaaf paida kar diya hai aur meri baat ka intezaar nahin kiya hai
Phir Moosa ne Saamiri se kaha ke tera kya haal hai

Us ne kaha ke main ne woh dekha hai jo un logon ne nahin dekha hai, to main ne numaainda-e-Parwardigar ke nishaan-e-qadam ki ek mutthi khaak utha li aur us ko gosaala ke andar daal diya, aur mujhe mere nafs ne isi tarah samjhaaya tha

Moosa ne kaha ke achchha ja door ho ja, ab zindagaani-e-duniya mein teri saza yeh hai ke har ek se yahi kehta phirega ke mujhe chhoona nahin, aur aakhirat mein ek khaas waada hai jis ki mukhaalifat nahin ho sakti. Aur ab dekh apne khuda ko jis ke gird tu ne e'tikaaf kar rakha hai, ke main use jala kar khaakistar kar doonga aur us ki raakh darya mein uda doonga
Yaqeenan tum sab ka khuda sirf Allah hai jis ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, aur wahi har shai ka wasee' ilm rakhne waala hai
Aur hum isi tarah guzashta daur ke waaqiaat aap se bayaan karte hain, aur hum ne apni baargaah se aap ko Quran bhi ata kar diya hai
Jo is se e'raaz karega woh qiyaamat ke din is inkaar ka bojh uthaaega
Aur phir usi haal mein rahega, aur qiyaamat ke din yeh bahut bada bojh hoga
Jis din Soor phoonka jaaega aur hum tamaam mujrimeen ko badle hue rang mein ikattha karenge
Yeh sab aapas mein yeh baat kar rahe honge ke hum duniya mein sirf das hi din to rahe hain
Hum un ki baaton ko khoob jaante hain, jab un ka sab se hoshyaar yeh keh raha tha ke tum log sirf ek din rahe ho
Aur yeh log aap se pahaadon ke baare mein poochhte hain ke qiyaamat mein un ka kya hoga, to keh dijiye ke mera Parwardigar inhein reza reza kar ke uda dega
Phir zameen ko chateel maidaan bana dega
Jis mein tum kisi tarah ki kaji naa-hamwaari na dekhoge
Us din sab daai-e-Parwardigar ke peechhe daud padenge aur kisi tarah ki kaji na hogi, aur saari aawaazein Rehmaan ke saamne dab jaayengi, ke tum ghunghunaahat ke ilaawa kuch na sunoge
Us din kisi ki sifaarish kaam na aaegi siwaaye un ke jinhein Khuda ne ijaazat de di ho aur woh un ki baat se raazi ho
Woh sab ke saamne aur peechhe ke haalaat se baakhabar hai, aur kisi ka ilm us ki zaat ko muheet nahin hai
Us din saare chehre Khuda-e-Hayy o Qayyoom ke saamne jhuke honge, aur zulm ka bojh uthaane waala naakaam aur ruswa hoga
Aur jo nek aamaal karega aur saahib-e-imaan hoga woh na zulm se darega aur na nuqsaan se

Aur isi tarah hum ne Quran ko Arabi zabaan mein naazil kiya hai aur is mein tarah tarah se azaab ka tazkira kiya hai ke shaayad yeh log parhezgaar ban jaayein ya Quran un ke andar kisi tarah ki ibrat paida kar de

Pas buland o bartar hai woh Khuda jo baadshaah-e-barhaq hai, aur aap wahi ke tamaam hone se pehle Quran ke baare mein ujlat se kaam na liya karein, aur yeh kehte rahein ke Parwardigar! Mere ilm mein izaafa farma
Aur hum ne Aadam se is se pehle ahd liya magar unhon ne use tark kar diya, aur hum ne un ke paas azm o sabaat nahin paaya
Aur jab hum ne malaaika se kaha ke tum sab Aadam ke liye sajda karo to Iblees ke ilaawa sab ne sajda kar liya aur us ne inkaar kar diya
To hum ne kaha ke Aadam! Yeh tumhaara aur tumhaari zauja ka dushman hai, kahin tumhein Jannat se nikaal na de ke tum zahmat mein pad jaao
Beshak yahaan Jannat mein tumhaara faaida yeh hai ke na bhooke rahoge aur na barahna rahoge
Aur yaqeenan yahaan na pyaase rahoge aur na dhoop khaaoge
Phir Shaitaan ne inhein waswase mein mubtala karna chaaha aur kaha ke Aadam! Main tumhein hameshgi ke darakht ki taraf rehnumaai kar doon aur aisa mulk bata doon jo kabhi zaail na ho

To un dono ne darakht se kha liya aur un ke liye un ka aaga peechha zaahir ho gaya, aur woh use Jannat ke patton se chhupaane lage, aur Aadam ne apne Parwardigar ki naseehat par amal na kiya to raahat ke raaste se be-raah ho gaye
Phir Khuda ne inhein chun liya aur un ki tauba qubool kar li aur inhein raaste par laga diya

Aur hukm diya ke tum dono yahaan se neeche utar jaao, sab ek doosre ke dushman honge. Us ke baad agar meri taraf se hidaayat aa jaaye to jo meri hidaayat ki pairwi karega woh na gumraah hoga aur na pareshaan
Aur jo mere zikr se e'raaz karega us ke liye zindagi ki tangi bhi hai, aur hum use qiyaamat ke din andha bhi mahshoor karenge
Woh kahega ke Parwardigar! Yeh tu ne mujhe andha kyon mahshoor kiya hai jab ke main daar-e-duniya mein saahib-e-basaarat tha
Irshaad hoga ke isi tarah hamaari aayatein tere paas aayin aur tu ne unhein bhula diya, to aaj tu bhi nazar-andaaz kar diya jaaega
Aur hum zyaadati karne waale aur apne Rab ki nishaaniyon par imaan na laane waalon ko isi tarah saza dete hain, aur aakhirat ka azaab yaqeenan sakht-tareen aur hamesha baaqi rehne waala hai

Kya inhein is baat ne rehnumaai nahin di ke hum ne un se pehle kitni naslon ko halaak kar diya jo apne ilaaqe mein nihaayat itmenaan se chal phir rahe the? Beshak is mein saahibaan-e-aql ke liye badi nishaaniyaan hain
Aur agar aap ke Rab ki taraf se baat tai na ho chuki hoti aur waqt muqarrar na hota to azaab laazmi taur par aa chuka hota

Lihaaza aap un ki baaton par sabr karein, aur aaftaab nikalne se pehle aur us ke doobne ke baad apne Rab ki tasbeeh karte rahein, aur raat ke auqaat mein aur din ke atraaf mein bhi tasbeeh-e-Parwardigar karein ke shaayad aap is tarah raazi aur khush ho jaayein

Aur khabardaar hum ne un mein se ba'z logon ko jo zindagaani-e-duniya ki raunaq se maala-maal kar diya hai us ki taraf aap nazar utha kar bhi na dekhein, ke yeh un ki aazmaaish ka zariya hai, aur aap ke Parwardigar ka rizq is se kahin zyaada behtar aur paaedaar hai
Aur apne ahl ko namaaz ka hukm dein aur us par sabr karein. Hum aap se rizq ke talabgaar nahin hain, hum to khud hi rizq dete hain, aur aaqibat sirf saahibaan-e-taqwa ke liye hai
Aur yeh log kehte hain ke yeh apne Rab ki taraf se koi nishaani kyon nahin laate hain? To kya un ke paas agli kitaabon ki gawaahi nahin aayi hai

Aur agar hum ne rasool se pehle inhein azaab kar ke halaak kar diya hota to yeh kehte ke Parwardigar! Tu ne hamaari taraf rasool kyon nahin bheja ke hum zaleel aur ruswa hone se pehle hi teri nishaaniyon ka ittibaa' kar lete
Aap keh dijiye ke sab apne apne waqt ka intezaar kar rahe hain, tum bhi intezaar karo, anqareeb maaloom ho jaaega ke kaun log seedhe raaste par chalne waale aur hidaayat-yaafta hain
